_comment: Single source of truth for every setting the five EXPERIMENT_MATRIX tables depend on. Values read from the frozen tree at tag paper-freeze-v1. NO SECRET IS PRESENT: collection.api_key is null here; the live key lives only in configs/config.yaml, which is gitignored and is NOT shipped.

determinism.ollama_concurrency: extract_paper_fields forces max_workers=1 whenever a seed is set -- concurrent Ollama requests get non-deterministic slot/prompt-cache assignment. Do not raise it.

stage4_extraction.reservation_note: 4096 was measured corpus-wide and NOT adopted (LATEX_ACQUISITION_REPORT Phase 5x, decision KEEP OFF). Production stays 768.

stage3_selection.fallback: content_aware silently falls back to legacy when the chunk schema has no block_type. Runs labelled content_aware on legacy chunks are PARTLY legacy.

evidence_grounding.enabled: true in configs/staging_config.yaml ONLY; false in production

anchor_rule.meaning: a decimal, or an integer of >=2 digits. Single digits never anchor a result.
anchor_rule.single_source_of_truth: src/evidence/anchors.py -- gate, Test 2 and every harness import it.

table3_ragas.context_selection: top-8 chunks by cosine similarity to the PRE-mutation claim; drop_chunk_ids removed from the pool first for support-deletion mutants
table3_ragas.criterion: should-REJECT detected iff faithfulness < 0.5; should-ACCEPT passed iff >= 0.5. Fixed before results were inspected. NaN never counts as a detection.

parity_gate.rule: fall back when latex_survival + tolerance < pdf_survival on ANY split

collection._note: REDACTED BY CONSTRUCTION -- never populate this file.
